name: After Hours #46 — On Air, Off Clock
description: The city through blinds, a board of sliders, and a lamp that means someone is still talking. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 46 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 2.4-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
